CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.app_usuario_actual_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT id FROM public.usuarios WHERE auth_id = auth.uid() LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_rol()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'public'
AS $function$
  select rol from public.usuarios where auth_id = auth.uid();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_usuario_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'public'
AS $function$
  select id from public.usuarios where auth_id = auth.uid();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.es_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(public.current_rol() = 'admin', false);
$function$

functions.signature: qms_classify(timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.qms_classify(p_due timestamp with time zone, p_attention timestamp with time zone, p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN p_due IS NULL THEN 'unconfigured' WHEN p_due<p_now THEN 'overdue'
 WHEN (p_due AT TIME ZONE 'America/Costa_Rica')::date=(p_now AT TIME ZONE 'America/Costa_Rica')::date THEN 'today'
 WHEN p_attention IS NOT NULL AND p_now>=p_attention THEN 'soon' ELSE 'within' END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.siguiente_folio_queja()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$
  select 'Q-' || extract(year from now())::text || '-' ||
         lpad(nextval('public.quejas_folio_seq')::text, 5, '0');
$function$
